title: Butuan haze eases, but air remains unhealthy for sensitive groups

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Haze in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte, slightly eased Sunday morning as particulate matter (PM) levels declined, but air quality remained unhealthy for sensitive groups, the city government said. Based on the 8 a.m. air quality assessment, the city’s two monitoring stations recorded PM2.5 levels within the “Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups” category. PM2.5 refers to tiny airborne particles measuring 2.5 micrometers or smaller. These particles are small enough to enter deep into the lungs and may affect health, especially among people who are more vulnerable to air pollution.
